items.titleZh: 比利时Dumarey集团将接手雷诺Viry引擎工厂
items.summaryZh: 雷诺已同意将位于Viry-Chatillon的引擎工厂出售给比利时Dumarey集团，该收购提案已提交给阿尔派车队。

media.altZh: 比利时Dumarey集团将接手雷诺Viry引擎工厂 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Belgian firm to take over Renault/Alpine engine facility in Viry
items.summaryEn: Renault has agreed to sell its Viry-Chatillon engine facility to Belgian company Dumarey Group, and the acquisition proposal has already been submitted to Alpine Racing.
detailZh: 比利时公司接手雷诺/阿尔派位于Viry的引擎工厂
在缩减F1引擎项目后，雷诺已为Viry工厂找到买家
Viry-Chatillon雷诺工厂鸟瞰图
雷诺已同意将位于Viry-Chatillon的引擎工厂出售给比利时公司Dumarey集团。
根据一份官方声明，专注于量产车辆动力总成及工程部件技术与开发的杜马雷集团，已准备接管该法国厂区。
该收购提案已提交给阿尔派车队。双方目前正积极推进对整个组织及其财务层面的全面分析，目标是确定如何快速推进后续工作。
根据该交易，杜马雷集团将收购位于维里-沙蒂永的 阿尔派 Racing SAS，包括“运营该厂区所需的团队以及有形和无形资产”。
维里位于巴黎南郊，数十年来一直是雷诺一级方程式引擎项目的所在地，并被视为法国赛车运动的重要枢纽。
但雷诺在去年年底关闭了其内部引擎部门，转而让 阿尔派 与梅赛德斯签署客户协议，这威胁到了维里数百名员工的未来。
阿尔派 也将在今年年底退出世界耐力锦标赛，此前该公司利用维里来维护和组装为其 A424 LMDh 赛车提供动力的 Mecachrome 制造引擎。
#35 阿尔派 耐力车队 阿尔派 A424：安东尼奥·费利克斯·达科斯塔、费迪南德·哈布斯堡、查尔斯·米莱西
该协议还可能对 阿尔派 的 Hypercar 项目产生影响，其工厂合作伙伴 Signatech 希望在 2027 年以不同品牌运营 A424。
在上个月的富士6小时耐力赛之后，Signatech似乎已准备与中国品牌吉利敲定协议，但两家公司之间的谈判似乎已经破裂。
2027赛季的报名截止日期是11月25日；必须在此前完成必要的正式文件，以确保获得Hypercar组别的席位。数周以来，车队负责人菲利普·西诺一直坚称，在工程师、机械师以及明年继续在锦标赛中推进A424项目所需的所有其他资源方面，一切均已就绪。
自然，组建一支新车队也需要签下必要的车手（例如注意到安东尼奥·菲利克斯·达科斯塔的离队），并确认已经参与该项目的车手。
杜马雷集团在声明中强调，其“正寻求将业务多元化拓展至赛车运动”，并表示该交易“为未来利用雷诺的一级方程式引擎专长为赛车队创造机会”。
阿尔派 Tech 副总裁阿克塞尔·普拉斯表示：“这笔交易是一个有力且连贯的机会，可以保障并进一步发展维里-沙蒂永基地的专业能力。它为员工和工程业务开辟了新的前景。这一发展是对该基地长期赛车运动专业能力的认可，尤其是在一级方程式方面。”
detailEn: Belgian firm to take over Renault/Alpine engine facility in Viry
Renault has secured a buyer for its Viry factory after curtailing its F1 engine programme
Aerial view of the Renault factory at Viry-Châtillon
Renault has agreed to sell its Viry-Chatillon engine facility to Belgian company Dumarey Group.

According to an official statement, the Dumarey Group, which specialises in technology and development of powertrains and engineering components for mass-produced vehicles, is prepared to take control of the French site.

The acquisition proposal has already been submitted to Alpine Racing. Both parties are now working diligently to analyse the entire organization and its financial aspects, with the goal of determining how to move forward quickly.
The deal will see Dumarey Group acquire Alpine Racing SAS, located in Viry-Chatillon, including "the teams and the tangible and intangible assets required to operate the site".
Located in the southern suburbs of Paris, Viry was the home of Renault's Formula 1 engine programme for several decades and was seen as an important hub for motorsport in France.

But Renault pulled the plug on its in-house engine department at the end of last year in favour of Alpine signing a customer deal with Mercedes, threatening the future of hundreds of employees at Viry.
Alpine is also exiting the World Endurance Championship at the end of the year, having used Viry to maintain and assemble the Mecachrome-built engines that power its A424 LMDhs.
#35 Alpine Endurance Team Alpine A424: Antonio Felix Da Costa, Ferdinand Habsburg, Charles Milesi
The deal could also have implications for Alpine's Hypercar programme, with its factory partner Signatech keen to run the A424 under a different brand in 2027.
Signatech appeared poised to finalise a deal with Chinese brand Geely after last month's Fuji 6 Hours, but the talks between the two firms appear to have broken down.

The deadline for entry into the 2027 season is 25 November; the necessary formal documentation must be finalised by then to secure a spot in the Hypercar class. For weeks, team principal Philippe Sinault has maintained that everything is in place, in terms of engineers, mechanics and all other resources required, to continue the A424 program in the championship next year.
Naturally, organising a new team also entails signing the necessary drivers (noting, for instance, the departure of Antonio Felix da Costa) and confirming those already involved in the programme.

In its statement, the Dumarey Group stressed that it is "seeking to diversify its activities into motorsport", saying the deal "creates opportunities to leverage Renault's Formula 1 engine expertise for racing teams in the future".

Axel Plasse, VP Alpine Tech, said: “This transaction represents a strong and coherent opportunity to secure and further develop the expertise of the Viry-Châtillon site. It opens up new prospects for employees and for the engineering business. This development is a recognition of the site’s longstanding motorsport expertise, particularly in Formula 1.”
keyPointsZh: Dumarey集团专注于量产车的动力总成及工程零部件技术与开发
此次出售发生在雷诺缩减其F1引擎项目之后
keyPointsEn: Dumarey Group specialises in technology and development of powertrains and engineering components for mass-produced vehicles
The sale follows Renault's curtailment of its F1 engine programme

items.titleZh: 贝尔曼与卡马拉竞争法拉利未来席位
items.summaryZh: 贝尔曼表示法拉利席位是他的终极目标，而拉斐尔·卡马拉加入哈斯表明法拉利仍在保留选择。

media.altZh: 贝尔曼与卡马拉竞争法拉利未来席位 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Why it's now Oliver Bearman versus Rafael Camara for the next Ferrari vacancy
items.summaryEn: Oliver Bearman has said a Ferrari seat is his "ultimate goal", while Rafael Camara's arrival at Haas shows Ferrari is keeping its options open.
detailZh: 为什么现在是奥利弗·贝尔曼与拉斐尔·卡马拉争夺法拉利下一个空缺席位
奥利弗·贝尔曼已确认法拉利席位是他的“终极目标”，但拉斐尔·卡马拉加入哈斯表明，这支车队仍在保留选择。
继任规划是F1车队负责人较为微妙的艺术之一。所有顶级车队都设有青训车手项目，明确目的是在比赛席位空缺时培养人才。
通常时机并不利于等待该空缺的车手。
作为法拉利车手学院的成员，奥利弗·贝尔曼在2025年被安排到哈斯车队，为他在法拉利可能的未来做准备。他尚未被确认将在2027年留在该车队，但这被认为只是形式上的问题。但现在他在争夺法拉利席位的竞争中将会有一个对手：F2锦标赛领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉，上周他被宣布为下赛季埃斯特班·奥孔的替代者。
在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前接受包括Motorsport.com在内的媒体采访时，贝尔曼承认了卡马拉被任命的重要性，但坚称他已准备好继续推进并证明自己配得上一支顶级车队的机会。
“我们同龄，”他说。“显然，拉法在F1的经验比我少。
“但是的，我想对法拉利来说，看看他们中期想放进车里的人选也是件好事。”
当然，我的目标是为自己争取到最有利的位置，让那个位置属于我。
我自己是忠于哈斯车队的，合同的期限并不真正属于我的职责范围。我很高兴能留在F1，但当然，从中长期来看，我也觉得自己已经准备好为领奖台而战、在前排竞争。
就中游车队而言，哈斯是我想要效力、并且我看到了自己未来的车队。但在某个时刻，我也觉得自己已经赢得了机会，去外面寻找一支前四的车队。
当然，考虑到我与法拉利的联系，那将是我的终极目标。
F2 领跑者卡马拉已根据旧车测试协议驾驶过一辆地面效应法拉利F1赛车。
从历史上看，年轻车手的机会窗口很难恰好对齐。近来出现了一种趋势，车队将最抢手的车手锁定在长期合同中。法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔就是其中之一，他在本赛季摩纳哥大奖赛前宣布将现有合同延长为“多年”。
鉴于勒克莱尔现有的安排据信将持续到2029年底，这表明他现在与法拉利车队绑定至2030年代——当然，其中会有解约条款。这样一来，就只剩下一个席位可能空缺：刘易斯·汉密尔顿的席位。
这位七届世界冠军将在2027年为法拉利效力，他已证明自己足够有竞争力，从而触发了现有合同中的表现条款。接下来会发生什么将取决于他下赛季的表现——但鉴于汉密尔顿将在1月年满42岁，可以合理预期他会比勒克莱尔更早腾出席位。
这对贝尔曼和卡马拉来说都是机会。但在这种情况下，对于经验更丰富的车手来说，危险在于他们在等待状态中停留的时间越长，其他人就越有可能出现并引起高层管理人员的注意。
勒克莱尔同样是法拉利车手学院的产物，他不必面对这种风险，因为当他在2018年被安排到索伯车队时，法拉利正寻求尽快替换基米·莱科宁，觉得需要一位更年轻、更有竞争力的车手来推动塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔，他们认为维特尔需要这样的推动。
当被问及与勒克莱尔的比较时，贝尔曼说：“这完全是时机问题，对吧？”
“我的意思是，查尔斯在[索伯]待了一年。他度过了非常好的一年，这给了他那个机会。就我而言，事情并没有那样发展。”
“时机看起来如何，始终是个问题。这就是一级方程式的现实。”
detailEn: Why it's now Oliver Bearman versus Rafael Camara for the next Ferrari vacancy
Oliver Bearman has confirmed a Ferrari seat is his "ultimate goal", but the arrival of Rafael Camara at Haas shows the Scuderia is keeping its options open

Succession planning is one of the more subtle arts of the Formula 1 team boss. All the top teams maintain junior-driver programmes with the explicit intention of developing talent for when a race seat falls vacant.
Often the timing doesn't work in favour of the driver waiting for that vacancy.

As a member of the Ferrari Driver Academy, Oliver Bearman was placed at Haas in 2025 to prepare him for a possible future at Ferrari. He is yet to be confirmed at the team for 2027 but this is understood to be a formality. But now he will have a rival in the race for a Ferrari seat: Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara, who was announced last week as the replacement for Esteban Ocon next season.

Speaking to media including Motorsport.com ahead of the US GP in Austin, Bearman acknowledged the significance of Camara's appointment, but insisted that he is ready to push on and prove himself worthy of an opportunity with a top-tier team.
"We're the same age," he said. "Obviously, Rafa has less experience than me in F1.
"But yeah, I guess that for Ferrari, it's also a good thing to see who they want to put in their car in the medium term.
"And of course, my goal is to put myself in the best position for that to be me.

"I'm committed to Haas myself and the length of the deal is not really my remit. I'm happy to be in F1, but of course, looking into the medium-long term, I also feel like I'm ready to fight for podiums and fight at the front.

"In terms of a midfield team, Haas is the team that I want to be with and I see my future with. But at some point as well, I feel like I've earned the opportunity to go out and look for a top-four team.
"And of course, with my link with Ferrari, that would be my ultimate goal."
F2 frontrunner Camara has driven a ground-effect Ferrari F1 car under Testing of Previous Cars protocols

Historically it is difficult for the window of opportunity for young drivers to align correctly. Recently there has been a trend for teams to lock the most in-demand drivers into long-term contracts. One such is Charles Leclerc at Ferrari, who announced a "multi-year" extension to his existing contract ahead of this season's Monaco Grand Prix.

Given Leclerc's existing arrangement is understood to run until the end of 2029, this suggests he is now tied to the Scuderia until the 2030s – although there will, of course, be break clauses. That leaves just one seat potentially up for grabs: Lewis Hamilton's.

The seven-time world champion will race for Ferrari in 2027, having proved competitive enough to trigger performance clauses in his existing contract. What happens next will hinge on how he performs next season – but, since Hamilton turns 42 in January, it's fair to expect that he will be vacating his seat sooner than Leclerc.

That is the opportunity for both Bearman and Camara. But the danger for the more experienced driver in this scenario is that the longer they remain in a holding pattern, the greater the likelihood of someone else coming along to catch the eye of senior management.

Leclerc, also a product of Ferrari's Driver Academy, didn't have to face that risk because when he was placed with Sauber in 2018, Ferrari was looking to replace Kimi Raikkonen as soon as possible, feeling that it needed a younger and more competitive driver to give Sebastian Vettel the push it believed he required.
"It's all a question of timing, right?" said Bearman when asked about the Leclerc comparison.
"I mean, Charles was there [Sauber] for one year. He had a very good year that gave him that opportunity. In my case, things didn't work out like that.
"It's always a question of how timing looks. That's the reality of Formula 1."
